headlines.description: Nestory Irankunda and Connor Metcalfe scored and Australia spoiled Türkiye's return to the World Cup for the first time in 24 years with a 2-0 victory on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Australia shock Türkiye to go level with USMNT

headlines.description: Kai Havertz scored two goals as Germany pulled away from World Cup first-timer Curaçao late in the opening half and piled on after that in a 7-1 win Sunday in a group match.
headlines.shortLinkText: Havertz double leads Germany in WC opening rout

headlines.description: Japan hit back twice to start their World Cup campaign with an entertaining 2-2 draw against the Netherlands.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kamada scores late equaliser as Japan hold Netherlands to draw

headlines.description: A late goal from Amad Diallo earned the Ivory Coast a 1-0 win in and end-to-end opening World Cup clash with Ecuador in Philadelphia.
headlines.shortLinkText: Utd's Amad scores late as Ivory Coast top Ecuador

headlines.description: Yasin Ayari scored twice, while Alexander Isak and Viktor Gyökeres were also on target as Sweden cruised to a dominant 5-1 victory over Tunisia to move atop World Cup Group F.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ayari scores twice as Sweden routs Tunisia 5-1

headlines.description: Cape Verde pulled off the shock of the 2026 World Cup thus far as they held European champions Spain to a battling goalless draw in their Group H opener in Atlanta.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain shocked by Cape Verde in World Cup opener

headlines.description: Romelu Lukaku's mere presence sparked an attack that led to Belgium's lone goal only seconds after he entered as a second-half substitute, helping his team earn a 1-1 draw with Egypt on Monday at the World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Egypt, Belgium tie as Lukaku makes instant impact

headlines.description: Maxi Araújo rescued a point for Uruguay to deny Saudi Arabia another famous World Cup win as the sides drew 1-1 in Miami.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bielsa's Uruguay rescue point against dogged Saudi

headlines.description: Ramin Rezaeian and Mohammad Mohebbi scored for Iran, with Eli Just grabbing a brace for New Zealand.
headlines.shortLinkText: Iran and New Zealand play out thrilling 2-2 draw

headlines.description: Brian Brobbey and Cody Gakpo scored two each as Netherlands cruised to a 5-1 World Cup victory over Sweden to go top of Group F.
headlines.shortLinkText: Netherlands thump Sweden 5-1 in statement win

headlines.description: A brace by substitute Deniz Undav fired Germany to a last-gasp 2-1 win over Ivory Coast to secure their place in the last 32 of the World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Undav goal earns Germany win vs. Ivory Coast

headlines.description: Room made 15 saves - the most by any goalkeeper in 90 minutes of a World Cup match since records began in 1966
headlines.shortLinkText: Eloy Room's record 15 saves shut out Ecuador as Curacao earn first World Cup point

headlines.description: A dominant Japan produced the biggest margin of victory for an Asian nation in a World Cup match as they beat Tunisia 4-0
headlines.shortLinkText: Japan rout Tunisia 4-0, eliminate Hervé Renard from the World Cup

headlines.description: Spain got their World Cup campaign back on track with a 4-0 victory over Saudi Arabia in Atlanta.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamal marks first WC start with goal in Spain win

headlines.description: Alireza Beiranvand made seven saves as Iran and 10-man Belgium played to a 0-0 draw at the World Cup on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Iran keeper stands tall in draw vs. 10-man Belgium

headlines.description: After holding Spain to a 0-0 draw, Cape Verde pulled off another impressive result with a draw against Uruguay.
headlines.shortLinkText: Impressive Cape Verde hold Uruguay to 2-2 draw

headlines.description: Mohamed Salah scored the go-ahead goal, and Egypt went on to defeat New Zealand 3-1 on Sunday night and secure a first-ever World Cup win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Salah leads rally as Egypt get first-ever WC win

headlines.description: A Nicolas Pépé brace powered Ivory Coast to a 2-0 win over Curacao.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ivory Coast make WC knockouts for the first time with 2-0 win over Curaçao

headlines.description: Ecuador produced a rousing fightback to come from behind and beat Germany 2-1 in their final Group E match in New Jersey to put themselves into the last 32 of the World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ecuador stun Germany to enter World Cup knockouts

headlines.description: Japan and Sweden booked their places in the knockout phase of the World Cup as they drew 1-1 in their final Group F clash in Dallas.
headlines.shortLinkText: Japan, Sweden share points, book knockout spots

headlines.description: Brian Brobbey scored his third goal of the World Cup, the Netherlands got a pair of goals that deflected off Tunisia into its own net, and the Dutch rolled in the rain to a 3-1 victory Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Netherlands see off Tunisia, set up Morocco clash

headlines.description: Australia and Paraguay played to a 0-0 draw Thursday night in a result that clinched a spot in the knockout round of the World Cup for the Socceroos and will likely be enough for the Paraguayans to advance.
headlines.shortLinkText: Australia advance with Paraguay likely to join

headlines.description: Kaan Ayhan scored on the final kick of the match, and Türkiye beat the United States 3-2 Thursday night for its only win of the World Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Türkiye beats much-changed USMNT with last-gasp goal

headlines.description: France forward Ousmane Dembélé scored a first-half hat trick, including one off a feed from Kylian Mbappé, to help his team beat Norway 4-1 at the World Cup on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dembélé hat-trick helps France past much-changed Norway

headlines.description: Senegal racked up the goals on 10-man Iraq in a 5-0 victory Friday that boosted their hopes of reaching the World Cup knockout stages.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senegal thrash Iraq, on course for knockouts

headlines.description: Cape Verde drew Saudi Arabia 0-0 to finish second in Group H
headlines.shortLinkText: Cape Verde's dream run continues, will face Argentina in R32

headlines.description: Spain defeated Uruguay 1-0 after another goalkeeping mistake by Fernando Muslera to advance to the knockout stage of the World Cup and eliminate the South American powerhouse.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spain beat Uruguay to win World Cup group

headlines.description: Egypt advanced past the group stage at the World Cup for the first time while Iran will have to wait to find out its fate after a 1-1 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: VAR denies Iran late winner as Egypt advance

headlines.description: Leandro Trossard scored a pair of goals and Belgium overcame a slow start at the World Cup to advance to the knockout round with a 5-1 victory over New Zealand on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Belgium through as group winners, with NZ out

headlines.description: Gabriel Martinelli scored late injury time to give Brazil a 2-1 win over Japan in the round of 32 at the World Cup on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brazil's Martinelli scores late winner to knock Japan out of World Cup

headlines.description: José Canale scored on the first sudden death penalty kick, Orlando Gill made two key saves in the shootout, and Paraguay upset Germany 4-3 on penalties Monday to earn the biggest upset of the 2026 World Cup so far.
headlines.shortLinkText: Paraguay upset Germany on pens, reach WC last 16

headlines.description: Netherlands knocked out of World Cup after penalty shootout loss to Morocco
headlines.shortLinkText: Netherlands out of WC after shootout loss to Morocco

headlines.description: Erling Haaland scored the deciding goal in the 86th minute as Norway won their first ever World Cup knockout match, advancing to the round of 16 with a 2-1 victory over Ivory Coast on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland strikes late to send Norway into last-16

headlines.description: Kylian Mbappé scored twice as France comfortably beat Sweden 3-0 in the World Cup round of 32.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mbappé stars, France thump Sweden at World Cup

headlines.description: Mexico will now face either England or DR Congo in Mexico City in the Round of 16.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jiménez, Quiñones help Mexico past Ecuador, into R16
